objective: Build the signed-knot engine and the slow loop, tune the slow loop's policy on rand 2.1 and block 2.5 at n = 800, and test with five runs per instance on rand 2.1, block 2.5, local window 10 and local window 40 at n = 3200 (and the held-out patterns at 800) against re-tuned Novelty+ and probSAT, static probing, random targets, untangle only, an oracle-tuned policy and CaDiCaL.
title: Guided structure mutation (untangle and braid) between epochs of a fast search, against the fast search alone, static probing and CaDiCaL
